items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I know he used to come there every Saturday and take his lessons.

ctx.x: He's dead now too, you know. Yeah, but he learned how to play on him in my house. Right there, you're from Tommy. Yeah, I can believe that because I know, he told me too, Muggsy, you told me too, Tommy was one of his favorites. He taught him. And when Tommy died, he wrote a little article in Downbeat about him. So he gave him credit as being one of the great ones.
He taught him. I know he used to come there every Saturday and take his lessons.
Do you mind telling how old you are now unless some people don't want to tell me? I'm 83. 83. What was your birth date when you...
